title: Range-based volatility, expected stock returns, and the low volatility anomaly
Stock return volatility, operating performance and stock returns: International evidence on drivers of the ‘low volatility’ anomaly
The Low Volatility Anomaly in Australian Stock Returns
Metal Returns, Stock Returns and Stock Market Volatility
abstract: Given the extensive participation of mining stocks in the Peruvian stock market, the Lima Stock Exchange (BVL) provides an ideal setting for exploring both the impact of metal returns on mining stock returns and stock market volatility, and the comovements between mining stock returns and metal returns. This research is a first attempt to explore these issues using international metal prices and the prices of the most important mining stocks on the BVL and the IGBVL index. title: Does Stock Market Volatility Forecast Returns?
Estimating Volatility of Daily Price Returns of Nigerian Stock Market
venue: Journal of Mathematical Techniques and Computational Mathematics
abstract: The financial markets are opened to market risk. Modelling the volatility in daily stock prices entails studying the particular error distribution that is most appropriate for the model. Considering a particular Nigeria stock market from April 1, 2016 to December 16, this study estimates both the symmetric and asymmetric volatilitymodels.The ARMA-GARCH, ARMA-EGARCH models were employed with the error distributions such as normal distribution, student t-distribution and skewed student t- distribution.
